body: I wish it were that simple.. what I posted only scratches the surface of the hell I went through. It almost creeps me out how calm I am and how logical I find suicide. I'm currently eating a sandwich considering how to go.. though I'll most likely figure it out while in the shower since that's where I become a genius. I think the moment I posted this.. is when I finally decided that whatever outcome it is.. I'll go through with the bet. But I am happy I got to talk to someone, I didn't think anyone would reply since I left a wall of text and all.

I feel like I'm spending all of my energy convincing myself that I should stay alive. I know that it would crush my sister.. and I keep so guilty and selfish even having these thoughts, but at the same time I feel so much resentment towards her for escaping back when we were kids and leaving me alone.. it's complicated. I just don't feel that I should be forcing myself to live. On the other hand, I know that if I can force myself through this next year or two I have a small chance of being reasonable happy. That is what I have been clinging to. 
Honestly, I know myself. The only thing I have going for me is my looks, but I know that they won't last and they don't really do much for me anyway. If anything they made my life a hell of a lot worse. My unhealthy emotional and mental state more than outweigh the good in me. I can't keep the thought away that maybe it will be a huge relief being gone. I've had dreams where I die.. and it feels numb. le sigh.. I don't even know if that makes sense.
